description: Scan a JavaScript/TypeScript project and list the dependencies it imports that changed after your training cutoff, with the specific API changes that affect this code. Use it at the start of a task in an unfamiliar project, or after dependencies were upgraded.

all.description: Check every direct dependency, not only imported ones

cutoff.description: Training cutoff (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) to use instead of a model id.

cwd.description: Project directory containing package.json (default: the server's working directory)

model.description: Your own model id (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). Defaults to the model configured in the coding agent's settings.

name: project_changes
title: Dependency changes since my training data (whole project)
